message.content:
Sure! Here are the results of each exponentiation:

| Operation | Result |
|-----------|--------|
| \(3^5\)   | \(243\) |
| \(2^3\)   | \(8\) |

So, raising 3 to the 5th power gives **243**, and raising 2 to the 3rd power gives **8**.
